name: brightcall-ai-agents
description: Review and edit the prompts, greetings, knowledge base, language and voice of your Brightcall AI phone agents.

interface.longDescription:
Manage your Brightcall AI voice agents directly in ChatGPT. Review what your agents say and know, then update their settings in plain language.

Connect your Brightcall account to find your AI agent projects and review their scripts, instructions, knowledge bases, and inbound and outbound greetings. Shorten a greeting, improve an instruction or add information to an agent's knowledge base. You can also look through an agent's recent calls with their transcripts, see the history of changes to an agent and go back to an earlier version.

Choose read-only access to review settings or read-and-write access to make changes. Preview and confirm updates before they are saved. Updates apply only to the selected fields, and an update is stopped if the agent has changed since it was read.

An existing Brightcall account is required. You can disconnect ChatGPT in Brightcall under General settings → Connected apps.
defaultPrompt: List my Brightcall AI agents and show their inbound greetings
Show the script and knowledge base for one of my Brightcall AI agents
Make an AI agent's outbound greeting shorter and friendlier, and show me the changes

positive.description: List the AI agents of the account
positive.expected_behavior: Lists only the AI agents the connected account is authorized for, by name, including Demo Receptionist.

positive.prompt: Show the script, instructions, knowledge base and greetings of the Demo Receptionist agent.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the current stored script, instructions, knowledge base and inbound and outbound greetings of Demo Receptionist.

positive.prompt: Change the inbound greeting of the Demo Receptionist agent to: Hello, you have reached Demo Company. How can I help you today?
positive.expected_behavior: Shows a preview and asks for confirmation. After confirmation saves the new greeting; reading the agent again shows it, and the other fields are unchanged.

positive.description: Append office hours to the knowledge base
positive.prompt: Add to the knowledge base of the Demo Receptionist agent: We are open Monday to Friday from 8:00 to 18:00.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows a preview, saves after confirmation, keeps the prior knowledge base content, and reading the agent again shows the added text.

positive.description: Change the script and add an instruction
positive.prompt: In the Demo Receptionist agent, change the script to ask for the caller's name first, and add the instruction: Always confirm the appointment date back to the caller.
positive.expected_behavior: Previews both changes, saves them after confirmation, and reading the agent again shows both while unrelated fields are unchanged.

negative.description: Placing phone calls is not supported
negative.prompt: Call +46 8 123 456 78 from my Demo Receptionist agent now.
Permanently delete my Demo Receptionist agent.

negative.description: Buying phone numbers is not supported
negative.prompt: Buy a new phone number for my Brightcall account.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: list, read and edit Brightcall AI voice agents, read their calls with transcripts, and view or revert the change history.
